description: 국가철도공단_해외 철도 기관 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 해외 철도 기관 데이터는 각국에서 운영되는 철도 기관들의 국가명, 기관명, 기관 주소, 전화번호, 팩스번호, 이메일, 홈페이지 등 기본 연락처 및 행정 정보를 체계적으로 제공하는 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 기관명, 기관주소, 기관전화번호, 해외철도기관, 연락정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
